releaseNotes:
# Nightify for Android 0.1.11

- Now Playing shows the next song and opens its queue when tapped.
- Tapping Play on an album or playlist rebuilds its track list and preserves songs you added by hand. Confirmed unavailable songs can be skipped during automatic playback so the rest of the album can continue.
- Reopening Nightify restores the full local queue, including longer playlists and duplicate song entries.
